description: Found as bycatch by the fz-kdt.93 verification refuter (2026-08-31): pingpong_cap.fz (repro in the session scratchpad -- a 3-cycle fnA -> grounded L1 -> grounded L2 -> direct fnA with both lambdas capturing) crashes the INTERP lane with compiler2_unreachable_control (executable 16, function 66, entry 1) while the JIT lane prints the correct answer (10).
